Remark
[Compact factors of singularity models are shrinkers] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0036 ↗ thm:chow-iii-ch17-compact-model-shrinker 1. ch17:17.18\group Finite Time Singularities

If the universal cover of a finite-time singularity model splits as $(\mathcal N^m,h(t))\times \mathbb R^{n-m}$ with $\mathcal N$ compact, then $(\mathcal N,h(t))$ is a shrinking gradient Ricci soliton.
